descriere_scurta: Transition point compensation rounding 1 positive zero range
descriere: Sets the rounding for point 1 positive (zero range) of the transition point compensation. The characteristic for the transition point compensation comprises the following value pairs: Flow rate (Q) / voltage (U) Positive range: - p1833 / p1834 --> Point 1 pos (zero range), rounding p1835 - p1839 / p1840 --> Point 2 pos, rounding p1841 - p1845 / p1846 --> Point 3 pos (saturation) Negative range: - p1836 / p1837 --> Point 1 neg (zero range), rounding p1838 - p1842 / p1843 --> Point 2 neg, rounding p1844 - p1847 / p1848 --> Point 3 neg (saturation)
